comments.content: The `os.RemoveAll` in the cleanup function should be checked for errors; ignoring it might lead to undetected issues when cleaning up temporary files.

summary.walkthrough: This pull request introduces a set of curated security rules for JavaScript, Python, and Ruby, which are embedded as assets for use with the semgrep scanner. The rules aim to identify common security vulnerabilities in code, enhancing the security analysis capabilities of the project.

change_groups.title: Add security rules for JavaScript, Python, and Ruby
change_groups.summary: This group of changes adds YAML files containing security rules for JavaScript, Python, and Ruby, which are designed to catch common vulnerabilities. The rules are embedded in the Go code to be used by the semgrep scanner, allowing for real-time security analysis during code reviews.

change_groups.title: Enhance semgrep scanner functionality
change_groups.summary: The semgrep scanner has been updated to support the new embedded rules. It now resolves configurations based on the changed paths in the codebase, allowing it to dynamically select the appropriate security rules to apply. Tests have been added to ensure the correct functionality of the new features.

summary.testing_notes: To test this change, run the semgrep scanner on a codebase with JavaScript, Python, and Ruby files that contain potential vulnerabilities as defined by the new rules. Verify that the scanner correctly identifies these vulnerabilities based on the embedded rules.
summary.risk: medium: The introduction of new security rules and modifications to the scanning logic may lead to false positives or missed vulnerabilities if not thoroughly tested.
